issues.description: The problem statement (UML) specifies an attribute order that should be followed by the constructor (numberOfInscribedStudents, lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfTutors). The solution's Lecture constructor uses a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). This mismatch between the UML/instructions and the provided solution can confuse students about the expected constructor signature and may cause tests or example usages to fail if they assume the UML order.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent with the UML and the problem instructions. Either update the solution constructor to match the UML order (e.g. public Lecture(int numberOfInscribedStudents, String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields accordingly) or modify the UML/instructions to document the constructor order used in the solution. Ensure template, problem statement, and solution all show the same constructor signature.
